FN-JDHHYYF-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 132
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/25/2025
Senate Bill 132 as introduced could decrease receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from the repealing of fines imposed on individuals under 21 years of age, ranging
between $50 to $400 per violation; decrease receipts to the State General Fund, county general
funds, municipal general funds and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could
decrease the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of individuals who would have been charged
and convicted of the offenses provided that are now repealed by this bill and the penalties that
have been removed.
